riskAnalysis: R01 found four blocking control defects: incomplete predecessor snapshots, raw-path canonicalization before rejection, overstated append coverage, and a transient-state test. The remediation freezes complete canonical Wave/base/amendment records from pre-transition bytes, applies one raw-string control-artifact validator to recovery and appended-amendment entries, executes real v2 semantic validation and the real append command in a temporary Git repository with success and atomic denial cases, and validates coherent recovery projections across lifecycle states. Because the changed code remains shared governance infrastructure, the full 108-test focused governance suite, all 118 governed-file quality checks, authority validators, generated views/site, legacy ECR, and diff hygiene were rerun at the exact remediation commit.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: A minimal recovery controller validates generic versioned GRR packets, exact independent review, explicit human approval, bounded bootstrap evidence, append-only remediation, and terminal disposition.
evidence: recoveryctl retains the complete governed transition set and now validates immutable evidence/ledger history on every transition.
The exact remediation commit passed the full 108-test focused suite and governed quality gate.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: The recovery controller semantically binds recovery, hold, target-Wave, base-Wave, consecutive unique predecessor amendment, bootstrap, post-bootstrap ECR/amendment, and proposed-task identity prefixes; structural schema validity alone never authorizes execution.
evidence: The semantic identity and authority validators remain mandatory.
The real ECR-0002/W1.A03 fixture passes semantic validation before append and denies wrong hold/task and nonconsecutive identities atomically.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: Every packet, approval, evidence, ledger, and authorized-scope path is canonical repository-relative POSIX, resolves inside its designated repository directory, and is rejected for absolute, backslash, dot-segment, traversal, redirected-parent, symlink, junction, or other escape behavior.
evidence: taskctl.canonical_control_artifact_path validates the raw spelling before resolution and is used by recovery evidence, recovery ledgers, and appended-amendment bootstrap evidence.
Command-entry tests deny absolute, backslash, dot, dot-dot, symlink, junction, and redirected-parent forms before artifact access.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: A controller-enforced hold denies all executable Wave/task/amendment/gate and older-reader paths until exact release conditions are satisfied.
evidence: The ACTIVE revision-4 hold and central taskctl mutation guard remain unchanged.
Direct resume and older-reader denial tests pass while W1 remains PAUSED and T03 BLOCKED.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: ECR validation supports generic subsequent identities and an ordered predecessor authority chain without changing ECR-0001, W1.A01, W1.A02, or their Git objects.
evidence: The v2 ancestry rule validates each predecessor packet-to-approval-to-effective-state lineage and requires the new packet to descend from the latest effective state.
Existing ECR-0001 validation passes, and the temporary ECR-0002 packet validates against exact W1.A01/A02 authority.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: A compare-and-swap append operation can add a subsequent approved amendment but cannot replace, reorder, duplicate, fork, or silently migrate an existing record.
evidence: save_validated now compares complete canonical frozen Wave/base/amendment records, and recovery save derives every expectation from pre-transition bytes.
The real append fixture denies duplicate, stale, reordered, nonconsecutive, wrong-hold, and wrong-task states without changing backlog bytes, then appends W1.A03 while preserving W1.A01/A02 exactly.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: Status and review pages provide a decision-complete stopped-recovery handoff with packet, authority, alternatives, and exact next approval or resume condition.
evidence: The append-only R01 findings and CHANGES_REQUESTED state render on the recovery and W1 pages.
The 147-page generated-site check and generated backlog-view check pass.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: Focused tests prove second and third GRR/ECR/amendment identities, cross-field identity binding, stale and dirty denial, self-review denial, predecessor preservation, older-reader denial, and atomic failure behavior.
evidence: The suite now combines generic GRR-0002/0003 and v2 schema fixtures with an executable ECR-0002/W1.A03 temporary-repository append.
All 108 focused tests pass at the exact remediation commit, including atomic record tamper, raw path, dirty, reviewer, and state-projection cases.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: B00 receives an independent control/security disposition before ECR-0002 is prepared or appended.
evidence: R01 is preserved as CHANGES_REQUESTED with four open blockers; this strict-descendant R02 submission requests independent replay and closure.
ECR-0002 exists only inside an ephemeral test fixture; no repository ECR-0002 packet or W1.A03 authority has been prepared or appended.

evidence: Complete canonical record snapshots cover base approval, lifecycle, tasks, completion/adoption, reviews, evidence, and checkpoints.
Atomic tamper tests alter each class and prove no write; the exact candidate changes no predecessor authority file or Git object.

The real append fixture validates exact ECR-0002/W1.A03 authority and denies mismatched boundaries.

Hostile identity, authority ordering, and path-entry tests pass.

The real append fixture and recovery atomic-writer tests verify byte-stable denial for stale, duplicate, reordered, wrong-boundary, tampered-record, dirty, and self-review cases.

The remediation diff contains only 13 authorized governance/evidence/test/generated paths and no product or UI-gate file.

evidence: The production hold still projects execution_authority false and W1.A03 is absent from the canonical backlog.
Only the temporary test fixture exercises append; separate exact human approval remains mandatory for a real ECR-0002/W1.A03.
